feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that our inequality

$$
-{x}^{2}+25>0,
$$

is a "*greater than*" inequality. Therefore, we need to find the values of $x$ for which the parabola

$$
y=-{x}^{2}+25
$$

 
is *above* the $x$-axis. We mark these values of $x$ in blue in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13972108/assets/b6b9353c183dee60c1f2df89d4b6ea3d47aa81a9030be9113a11d0b9c61c7682.png)

So, the solution to the inequality is $-5<x<5.$
